Role Profile
FTSE Russell is a leading global index provider, creating and managing benchmark, analytics and data solutions used by asset owners, asset managers, investment banks, ETF providers and other financial institutions worldwide. The role sits within the Equities & Multi-Asset Index Research & Design team, a global group responsible for the development, design, research and enhancement of index methodologies, analytics and investment solutions. The team works closely with Engineering, Technology, Data Operations, Product, Sales and clients to deliver innovative index capabilities and analytical solutions.
We are seeking a highly technical and versatile Senior Analyst, Quantitative Research & Development who enjoys solving problems across quantitative development, data analysis, research and operational delivery. This is a hands-on role requiring the ability to switch rapidly between priorities: one day developing a Python research tool or AI-enabled workflow, another investigating a complex data issue, validating investment analytics or supporting a research or client request. The successful candidate will take ownership of problems from investigation through resolution and be comfortable working across multiple teams and disciplines.
Key Responsibilities
• Develop, test and maintain Python and SQL-based research tools, investment analytics and data pipelines, applying strong software engineering and CI/CD practices.
• Perform detailed data analysis, validation and quality assurance across large financial datasets; investigate anomalies and identify root causes across data, code and methodology.
• Develop automation and AI-enabled tools and agents to improve research, data checking and operational workflows.
• Support quantitative investment and index research, including factor analysis, regression, portfolio optimisation, risk modelling and performance analytics.
• Work with datasets and platforms including Worldscope, IBES, Lipper, Datastream and Refinitiv Workspace, developing a strong understanding of their structure, coverage and appropriate application.
• Partner with Research Analysts, Engineering, Technology and Data Operations to translate analytical requirements into robust, scalable solutions.
• Support index research, methodology development, rebalances and other operational activities where strong analytical and technical expertise is required.
• Respond to internal and external analytical enquiries and contribute to client-facing analysis and materials.
• Continuously improve existing code, processes and research infrastructure with a focus on scalability, automation, accuracy and maintainability.
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will have approximately 5 years of experience in quantitative development, financial data analytics, quantitative research or a related discipline, with strong hands-on Python and SQL skills. Experience with pandas, NumPy, Git, testing, CI/CD, cloud computing and modern development environments such as VS Code and GitHub Copilot is highly desirable, as is practical experience developing with generative AI and AI agents. Candidates should have a good understanding of equity markets and quantitative techniques such as regression, optimisation, factor investing and risk modelling, combined with a rigorous approach to financial data and quality assurance. Above all, we are looking for an agile, curious and highly motivated problem solver who pays meticulous attention to detail, learns quickly, takes ownership and is comfortable juggling multiple priorities in an environment where the skills required can change from one task to the next.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
Parexel is in the business of improving the world’s health. We do this by providing a suite of biopharmaceutical services that help clients across the globe transform scientific discoveries into new treatments. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, our therapeutic, technical, and functional ability is underpinned by a deep conviction in what we do. We believe in our values, Patients First, Quality, Respect, Empowerment & Accountability.
We are currently recruiting for Clinical Research Associate II and Senior Clinical Research Associate to join our Multi-Sponsor Clinical Trials Team in the UK.
This role if fully decentralised in the UK.
Your time here
At Parexel, the CRA role offers the opportunity to go beyond the role of a typical clinical monitor. CRA’s are accountable for using their expertise to build and maintain the site relationship and ensure they’re set up for success. As the clinical sites’ sole point of contact, this includes addressing and resolving site issues and questions. You’ll also manage site quality and delivery from site identification through to close-out.
As a CRA, Parexel will offer you world class technology and training catered to your individual experience. You can anticipate less travel and a lower protocol load in comparison to industry peers. Your hard work may be rewarded through a bonus incentive program, the opportunity to work within multiple therapeutic areas and an opportunity to advance your career in clinical research. If impact, flexibility, and career development appeal to you, Parexel could be your next home.
What you’ll do
• Leverage your expertise. Conduct qualification visits (QV), site initiation visits (SIV), monitoring visits (MV) and termination visits (TV) at assigned clinical sites and generate visit/contact reports.
• Build relationships. Oversee integrity of the study and utilize problem-solving skills to promote rapport with the site and staff.
• Protect patients. Review the performance of the trial at designated sites, ensure the rights and well-being of human subjects are safeguarded and are in accordance with protocol.
• Drive productivity. Develop patient recruitment strategies in conjunction with the clinical site to meet enrollment timelines, while also ensuring compliance with the approved standard operating procedures (SOPs), protocol/amendment(s), GCP, and the applicable regulatory requirement(s).
• Ensure quality. Evaluate the quality and integrity of the reported data, site efficacy and drug accountability.
• Execute. Monitor the completeness and quality of Regulatory Documentation and perform site document verification.
More about you
On your first day we’ll expect you to have:
• Site Management or equivalent experience in clinical research, with understanding of clinical trials methodology and terminology.
• Ability to perform all clinical monitoring activities independently.
• Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in biological science, pharmacy or other health related discipline.
• Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills within a matrixed team.
• Experience working in a self-driven capacity, with a sense of urgency and limited oversight.
• A client-focused approach to work and flexible attitude with respect to assignments/new learning.
• The ability to manage multiple tasks, evaluate a variety of unpredictable scenarios and achieve project timelines while being able to apply your understanding of study protocol(s).
• An honest and ethical work approach to promote the development of life changing treatments for patients.
• Strong computer skills, including but not limited to the knowledge of a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) and MS-Office products such as Excel and Word.
If you are ready to join Parexel’s Journey, please apply!

Annual Salary Review

In this role, you’ll build your skills across our four specialist areas;
•
Guidance - figuring out a suitable trajectory, providing an effective route to target interception and improving the probability of defeating a target
•
Control - designing and tuning autopilot algorithms, for various control surfaces, to maintain stable flight dynamics and achieve the guidance demands
•
Navigation - estimating the current missile state (position, velocity and altitude/orientation) using measurements from a range of on-board sensors
•
Command and Control - designing weapon-system level algorithms to track and evaluate incoming threats, plan engagements, and provide additional mission context to the operator
This is a great environment and opportunity to learn, broadening your technical knowledge of the design and function of a complex weapon system through visibility of a wide range of work; from researching and developing futuristic technologies through to being on the design team for current high-profile projects.

Integrated navigation, such as 'Terrain Reference Navigation', 'GPS integration', and ‘Image Based Navigation’

Autopilot and control system design and analysis, including dual-mode control, thrust vector control, etc.

Algorithms for mid-course guidance, terminal guidance, target tracking and selectivity

Implementing AI techniques including neural networks and deep learning to improve traditional GCN algorithms and solve new challenges
•
Designing autonomous decision-making systems for use in complex collective missions.
Work collaboratively across engineering teams to develop your understanding of propulsion, aerodynamics, seekers, sensors and actuators, and how these technologies integrate within a complex missile system. Degree qualified in Physics, Mathematical Sciences, Engineering or Computing discipline to a minimum of 2:2

A CAWDE Operator at the Airbus Filton plant operates Electroimpact’s 5-axis Composite Automated Wing Drilling Equipment (CAWDE) to execute high-precision drilling, countersinking, and temporary bolt insertion during the assembly of A400M wing boxes.
Role Overview
• Location: Airbus Filton Facility (Bristol, UK)
• Program: Airbus A400M Military Transport Aircraft Wing Production
• Primary Equipment: Electroimpact 5-Axis Traveling-Column CNC Post Mill with ride-on operator platform
• Materials Worked: Multi-material stacks including Carbon Fiber Reinforced Plastic (CFRP) wing skins, aluminum/titanium ribs, composite spars, and engine pylon reinforcements.

Role: AI Commerce Search Sr. Engineer/Architect
Location: London
Level: Associate Manager
About Accenture Song
Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. Within Song, our Commerce & AI practice helps organizations design, build, and scale modern digital commerce ecosystems - embedding Generative AI and Agentic AI into commerce to enable real-time personalization, autonomous merchandising, intelligent discovery, and customer engagement at scale. Visit us at: www.accenture.com/song
About the role
AI is rewriting how people find and buy. Discovery is shifting from keyword search boxes to conversational, agent-mediated experiences - across both a brand's owned platforms and the AI surfaces where customers increasingly begin their journey. We are looking for a technically strong architect to lead the design and delivery of Google-powered AI commerce experiences - with intelligent, AI-native search and discovery at the core, extending across the wider set of on-platform agentic commerce use cases.
You will work at the intersection of enterprise commerce platforms and Google's agentic AI stack - Vertex AI Search for Commerce, Gemini Enterprise (GECX), Google Cloud Agents, Vertex AI Agent Builder / ADK, and the Customer Engagement Suite - translating commerce strategy into production-grade, grounded, and commercially reliable AI systems.
This role leans into Google Cloud AI platforms as the delivery foundation. Search and discovery is your anchor specialism, but your remit spans the broader on-platform agentic commerce agenda: conversational commerce, personalization, merchandising optimization, product knowledge and content, and the GEO / AI-native discoverability that determines whether a brand shows up accurately in LLM-mediated discovery.
You are hands-on, technically rigorous, and comfortable owning the technical design of a solution workstream - making well-reasoned build-vs-buy decisions and translating complex architecture into clear recommendations for both engineering teams and senior client stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
• Owning the technical design of AI-powered commerce search and discovery workstreams on Vertex AI Search for Commerce — relevance tuning, ranking, retrieval, merchandising controls, and query understanding — and ensuring the approach is scalable, grounded, and aligned to client constraints.
• Designing broader on-platform agentic commerce experiences on Google's stack — conversational commerce, guided shopping, personalization and next-best-action, and merchandising optimization — using Gemini Enterprise (GECX), Google Cloud Agents, and Vertex AI Agent Builder / ADK.
• Designing the knowledge and data architecture that underpins search and agent intelligence — structured product data, embedding pipelines, vector retrieval, semantic search, and RAG grounded on commerce-specific intent, product relationships, and category hierarchies.
• Architecting integration between Google AI surfaces and the enterprise commerce stack - OMS, PIM, DAM, CRM, payments, and fulfilment — via APIs, event-driven patterns, and emerging agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, ACP).
• Leading GEO / AEO and AI-native discoverability design — structuring and exposing product content so brands remain visible, accurate, and preferred across AI-driven discovery surfaces.
• Contributing to build-vs-buy decisions across Google AI platform services, LLM/model choices (incl. Model Garden), orchestration frameworks, and vector stores — with a well-reasoned technical point of view grounded in delivery experience.
• Embedding AI governance, observability, and responsible AI into design as first-class concerns - audit logging, human-in-the-loop escalation, grounding/hallucination controls, brand safety, and performance monitoring.
• Providing technical leadership to delivery teams — guiding engineers, reviewing technical decisions, and maintaining architectural coherence across the workstream lifecycle.
• Leading technical workshops and architecture reviews with client stakeholders — presenting options with clear trade-offs, effort implications, and business outcomes for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Supporting the development of Accenture Song's AI commerce capability — contributing to reference architectures, accelerators, and points of view that advance our delivery standards.
What We Are Looking For
Required Experience
• ~6 years of professional experience in technical architecture, solution engineering, or software engineering — with meaningful delivery across enterprise platforms and a growing specialism in AI and agentic systems.
• Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI-powered search, discovery, or recommendation systems in production - relevance, ranking, retrieval, and query understanding.
• Demonstrable, hands-on experience with Google Cloud AI platforms applied to commerce - one or more of Vertex AI Search for Commerce, Gemini Enterprise (GECX), Vertex AI Agent Builder / ADK, or the Customer Engagement Suite.
• Hands-on experience with Generative AI and agentic systems - LLM-powered application design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and at least one agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI).
• Experience designing and building data and context pipelines for AI systems -=embedding pipelines, vector databases, and semantic search over structured commerce data.
• Hands-on delivery on at least one major enterprise commerce platform - such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Commercetools, SAP Commerce, or a composable / MACH-aligned stack - and a solid understanding of how these integrate with surrounding enterprise systems.
• Familiarity with emerging agentic commerce protocols - MCP, A2A, or ACP - and how they connect AI agents to commerce systems and product data.
• Working knowledge of cloud-native services and CI/CD-based delivery (GCP preferred).
• Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI - observability, tracing, auditability, grounding, and guardrails in production AI systems.
• Experience leading technical design sessions and presenting architecture options to senior client or stakeholder audiences.
Preferred Experience
• Familiarity with GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AI-native search — how product data must be structured and exposed to remain visible and accurate in LLM-mediated discovery.
• Experience with Google's broader agent ecosystem - Model Garden, Agent Engine, AgentOps, and grounding/RAG on enterprise data.
• Hands-on AgentOps / LLMOps practices - production monitoring, model evaluation, tracing, and continuous improvement for deployed AI systems.
• Exposure to composable commerce patterns - MACH principles, headless…

Product Governance Specialist
Job Description
Location: London, UK (Hybrid: 3 days in office)
Employment type: Permanent, full time
Reporting into: Product Operations Lead
So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
Your Team:
This role sits within the new Product Operations team, reporting to the Product Operations Lead, and works closely with stakeholders across IG, including Compliance, Risk and Legal. You’ll be the connective tissue between these functions and IG’s product squads, ensuring the relevant stakeholders are engaged from ideation throughout the product lifecycle. You will help translate the requirements and advice provided by these specialist functions into clear, practical actions for product managers and support their implementation, helping ensure products are compliant, robust and appropriately controlled from launch and throughout their lifecycle.
Your role in the Team’s Success:
This is a role for someone who lives at the intersection of product and compliance, and enjoys it. As Product Governance Specialist you will be the product organisation's in-house expert on product governance to ensure that all products are subject to effective lifecycle governance, including appropriate review, approval, launch, ongoing monitoring, periodic review and maintenance in accordance with IG’s product governance framework and the Consumer Duty rules.
What you’ll do:
Product governance and lifecycle oversight
• Own and continuously improve IG's new product approval process, ensuring all new products and material changes engages the appropriate stakeholders, and is assessed, documented, and signed off before launch.
• Ensure clear ownership and effective governance throughout the product lifecycle, including ongoing monitoring and annual reviews to confirm that products remain appropriate, operate as intended and deliver good customer outcomes.
• Establish appropriate product MI covering performance, customer service, complaints, incidents, target-market alignment and fair value.
• Work with product owners and relevant stakeholders to identify, escalate, track and resolve product risks, control weaknesses and adverse customer outcomes.
• Maintain the Product Governance Policy and supporting processes, controls and governance reporting, incorporating requirements and advice from relevant specialist functions.
• Run and document the annual product review process, working with product owners and relevant stakeholders across IG to confirm that products continue to operate as intended, remain appropriate for their target market, deliver fair value and meet applicable manufacturer and distributor obligations under the Consumer Duty rules.
Product disclosures, risk warnings and customer communications
• Support the Product Managers and Designers in ensuring that  product disclosures, risk warnings and other regulatory disclosures across products, reflect the requirements advised by Compliance, are applied consistently and remain clear and appropriately prominent across products and customer journeys.
• And that new products, features and changes are reviewed before launch to identify and implement any required risk warnings, disclosures or customer communications.
Cross-functional collaboration
• Act as the trusted link between Product and other functions across IG, including Compliance, Legal & Risk, resolving governance questions quickly rather than letting them become blockers.
• Train and support product managers on governance requirements, building governance literacy across the wider team.
• Support the Product Operations Lead, Product Domain Leads and CPO in preparing materials for senior governance committees.
What You'll Need:
• Practical experience designing, operating or overseeing product governance frameworks and new product approval processes within a UK FCA-regulated financial services firm.
• Strong working knowledge of Consumer Duty, PROD and UK MiFID II requirements, including their application to product design, approval, monitoring, review and customer communications.
• Experience running or contributing to new product approval and annual product review processes.
• Comfortable producing MI and materials for senior committees and, where relevant, board-level reporting.
• Ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical guidance that product teams can actually use.
• Excellent written communication, with the judgement to know when something needs escalating versus when it can be resolved directly.
Desirable
• Experience with investment, leveraged trading, or crypto products specifically.
• Background in either a product role that moved into governance, or a compliance role that developed strong product fluency.
• Familiarity with vulnerable customer frameworks and fair value assessment methodologies.
The Perks
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.

Let’s go on an adventure together!
Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.

You won’t have two days that look the same.

• Generate security KPI and metrics reporting across security programs to measure progress and effectiveness, and present findings to senior leadership.

• Proficiency in multiple programming languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python).
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing technical policy, standards, or training materials.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred qualities

• Track record of thought leadership: publications, conference talks, published CVEs, or contributions to security/API standards bodies (e.g., IETF OAuth/JOSE working groups).
